links.outcome: Concordance of ChatGPT top 1 and top 5 differential diagnoses with final diagnosis by atypicality category
links.effect: Category 1: top 1 17% (n=1), top 5 67% (n=4). Categories 3 and 4: 0% top 1 and markedly lower top 5. Top 5 accuracy differed significantly between less and more atypical cases (P=.048); top 1 did not (P=.13).
links.quote: ChatGPT's diagnostic accuracy decreased with an increase in atypical presentation.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT-4 on 25 published clinical vignettes representing atypical disease presentations without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
